mainEntity.name: Why are my kitchen cabinets falling apart so quickly?
mainEntity.text: Why are my kitchen cabinets falling apart so quickly?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's super frustrating when your kitchen cabinets start showing wear and tear long before they should. Often, cabinets falling apart quickly can come down to a few key issues that are actually pretty common. One big one is subpar installation; if they weren't anchored correctly or leveled properly from the start, stress points can develop, leading to doors sagging or drawers sticking. Another factor is the quality of the materials themselves. Cheaper materials might not hold up to the humidity fluctuations of a kitchen or the daily wear and tear. Water damage from leaks or even just steam can also wreak havoc on cabinet finishes and structure over time. Lastly, how they're used matters – constantly overloading shelves or slamming doors can accelerate damage. If you're seeing issues, it might be time to have a professional like Simply Construction take a look. We can assess the damage, suggest repairs, or discuss options for durable, professionally installed cabinets that are built to last in your Las Vegas home. Getting it right the first time can save you a lot of hassle!
